mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings growth and increasing recession risk, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 8% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained GDPC1 decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150k signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and reduces recession risk, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained PAYEMS > 150k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and increases recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 500k signals weakening residential investment, which reduces construction-related earnings and compresses economic growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained HOUST < 500k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below 97 signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and increases recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained INDPRO < 97 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Personal Income (RSAFS) above 350k signals strengthening consumer purchasing power, which boosts corporate revenue growth and profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained RSAFS > 350k (t-test p > 0.05).
